About Product

\nEnviro Brine+ Hard Water Conditioner is designed to protect homes from the damaging effects of hard water caused by high levels of calcium and magnesium minerals commonly found in borewell water. \n \nIt helps reduce white scaling and mineral deposits on taps, showerheads, bathroom tiles, pipelines, geysers, and other household appliances, keeping your home cleaner and better protected. \n \nThe advanced conditioning technology utilizes a proprietary process that alters the behavior of calcium minerals, helping them remain in a non-adherent state and reducing their tendency to form hard scale deposits inside pipes and on surfaces. \n \nBy minimizing scaling and corrosion, the system helps extend the lifespan of plumbing networks, geyser heating elements, washing machines, and other utility equipment. \n \nIt also improves the bathing experience by reducing the harsh effects of hard water on skin and hair, contributing to a cleaner and healthier living environment. \n \nThe conditioner operates without chemicals and features odourless, tasteless, and pH-neutral media, making it suitable for residential borewell water applications. \n \nIdeal for independent houses, villas, apartments, farmhouses, residential complexes, and utility water lines, Enviro Brine+ delivers reliable performance with minimal maintenance requirements. \n \n

desc:
\n

The 250 Litre Stainless Steel (SS) Water Storage Tank is a durable and hygienic solution for storing clean water in residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Manufactured from high-quality food-grade stainless steel, the tank is designed to resist rust, corrosion, and contamination, ensuring that stored water remains safe, fresh, and odor-free. Its robust construction provides excellent strength and long service life, making it an ideal alternative to conventional plastic storage tanks.

\n

With a 250-litre capacity, this tank is suitable for homes, apartments, offices, restaurants, hospitals, schools, and small commercial establishments. The smooth stainless steel surface minimizes the buildup of algae, bacteria, and sediments, making cleaning and maintenance simple. Its leak-proof welded construction ensures reliable performance, while the polished finish enhances durability and complements modern installations.

\n

Designed for long-term performance, the 250 Litre SS Tank withstands varying weather conditions and maintains the quality of stored water without affecting its taste or odor. Whether used for drinking water, domestic water storage, or commercial applications, it provides a safe, hygienic, and dependable water storage solution.

\n \n
